page.layout: One page of text, single column, with the running head at the top and the page number 146 beside it. Lists are set as numbered lines throughout. A catchword stands at the lower right.

main_text.p: exhortatione ad populum; postquam ad ista interrogata pu-blicè responderit.
main_text.l: I. An se legitimè sentiat ad hoc ministerium vocatum.
II. An sola Biblica scripta pro Dei verbo recipiat.
III. An ea fideliter populo prædicare velit, vitâ inculpatâ præeundo.
IV. An se subjiciat Ecclesiasticæ Disciplinæ.
main_text.p: Qui semel legitimè in S.Ministerio sunt confirmati,illud dum vivunt non deserent, nisi legitima incidat occasio, de quâ judicium erit penes Synodum Provincialem vel Nationalem.
Nemo ab aliâ vocatus Ecclesiâ ad eam se conferet, nisi cum Ecclesiæ suæ consensu & Classis approbatione.
main_text.l: 1. Verbum Dei cum reverentiâ & simplicitate prædicare.
5. Et procurare ut omnia decenter & ordine peragantur.
main_text.p: Si Minister donum habet aliquid ad ædificationem conscribendi,illud typis non mandabit, quin prius à Classe examinetur & probetur.
Honesta & justa merces Ministro danda est.
Si quis senio vel morbo fiat ad Ministerium inutilis, ab Ecclesiâ nihilominus alendus est.
De Ministrorum viduis & orphanis similiter habenda est ratio.

page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout ("fe" as se, "fentiat" as sentiat, "ifta" as ista, "minifterium" as ministerium, "Ecclefiafticæ" as Ecclesiasticæ). Printed V in SYNODORVM and in "Ecclefiafticæ" spelling changed to U/V per rule. The "Qui" opening carries an underline under the Q, not transcribed. The catchword "XII. Cæ-" is taken as printed at the lower right. Printed spacing "conscribendi,illud" and "confirmati,illud" kept as set.
